subject: general
question: DNST is related to STDN in a certain way based on a certain relationship between the given letters. In the same way RXMK is related to MKRX. To which of the following is WBGH related to following the same logic?
solution:
**Logic: Letters are rearranged.**

DNST is related to STDN →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe6d61168e5d5b76d5c2a567f7758e18e5e9354997f397f58db8d5a93dd5f87f.png] 

RXMK is related to MKRX →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d621cf598bd3c713784380e7cc16a6b3ca6515999d1e0e6e6c22be815e4ac20.png] 

Similarly, 'WBGH' will be related to:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18b0b3630881276d3476b2f0e42069d4b9d2946f569b368bf5c3009dd3a9ebfd.png] 

Here, 'WBGH' is related to** 'GHWB'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
